name: Button
note: TButton; full Init key set (tooltip read but unused); label etc come from style.lua

name: Slider
note: TSlider; orientation from hslider or h<w; no range keys

name: TextEdit
note: registered as TCustomTextEdit (Main 0x2952c overrides TTextEdit); Init chain TCustomTextEdit, TTextEdit 0x8c31c, TText 0x55550

name: Rollover
note: contents is Lua source run on each hover via DoLuaString into a PopupWindow; always fits to children

name: BitmapTint
note: TBitmapTint over TImage::Init 0x866e2; dx,dy default -9999; w,h default -1

name: BSGWindow
note: TBSGWindow::PostChildrenInit; fill default true, color default (1,1,1,0)

name: TightText
note: TTightText; size forced to 800x600 then shrunk to text bounds + pad (default 3)

name: XSellWindow
note: TXSellWindow; no own style keys; registered by AttachWindowScript (0x4e480); constructor registers SetupXSell and LaunchGameLink; unused by shipped Lua
